articles.summary: The Trade Desk, a leading global advertising technology company, today announced that Dave Pickles—company co-founder who previously served as CTO and stepped down in 2023—is returning to the company in a newly expanded technology leadership capacity. In this role, Pickles will establish and lead a new CTO Council, partnering with The Trade Desk’s world-class engineering and product teams to provide direct guidance on the company’s core technology and product development roadmap. Leveraging his deep history as co-founder and former CTO, Pickles will help shape the next generation of The Trade Desk platform, with a sharp focus on aligning technology strategy, architectural direction, operational excellence, and key engineering investments—including agentic capabilities and advanced AI-powered advertising workflows. articles.title: The Trade Desk Strengthens Leadership Bench, Expands Engagement with Dave Pickles

articles.summary: The Trade Desk also announced a $731 million increase to its share repurchase authorization, bringing the total amount available for future repurchases to $1 billion of its Class A common stock. The Trade Desk, Inc.
